title: Contamination fear
prompt: I touched a door handle and my hands feel contaminated and I want to scrub them — but they look completely clean and I haven't touched anything actually dirty.
baselineRules: Wash when hands are actually dirty — visible grime, soap, food, or chemicals — not just when they feel dirty.
A feeling of contamination is not the same as real dirt.
One proper wash is complete; repeating adds no real safety.
Anxiety is a feeling, not proof of contamination.
